Show an unprivileged party who inscribes prefix-matching Bitcoin reveals so that the bytes an honest aggregate resolves to are not the bytes the batch prover chunked - a wtxid the attacker can land first, a chunk that changes the decompressed proof, or a body that makes `process_complete_proof` accept a state transition the prover never produced. Binding: the complete proof `process_complete_proof` verifies == the byte string the batch prover signed and chunked.'
